meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.22.11;
father of: Zedekiah (H6667)
§ Chenaanah = "trader"
1) father of Zedekiah the false prophet of Ahab
2) son of Bilhan, grandson of Jediael, and great grandson of Benjamin and the founder of a house of Benjamin

elsewhere.note: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’ ”
The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’ ”
